scope: P01-P08 systemic visual-polish, display-module, photo-proxy, carry-over and execution-ownership rules
reason: P01 exposed generic-native design, carry-over, contaminated photo-proxy and workflow-order failures. Production must not jump into Figma before feedback has been written back to authority.

chatgptResponsibilities: review Codex result against Visual Master and manifests
codexResponsibilities: Drive/Git production evidence updates when instructed
workflowOwnership.hardRule: ChatGPT must not jump ahead into direct Figma modification or production image generation while manifest/feedback work is still open. Direct Figma/ImageGen work by ChatGPT requires a new explicit user instruction that reassigns that work.
workflowOwnership.handoffGate: Do not hand off to Codex until the relevant systemic and page-specific feedback is represented in required authority and contradictory older behavior has an explicit override.
workflowOwnership.why: The user wants design mistakes converted into reusable production knowledge before another implementation cycle begins.

priorityOverride.rule: For V30 production after 2026-09-02, this manifest is a required execution override. Where an older root/acceptance rule permits Visual Master crops as photo proxies or implies fixed display text must remain editable in Figma, this newer rule wins unless the user explicitly says otherwise.
priorityOverride.doNotInfer: Do not silently fall back to older proxy/display-text behavior because it is already implemented.

bundledFixedDisplayModulePolicy.principle: When a short fixed display element is visually authored as one editorial object, generate/prepare the complete visible module as one asset instead of decomposing it into generic Figma text + generic shapes.
eligibleExamples: short fixed name/title lockup when approved spelling is known

figmaEditability.rule: For approved short fixed display modules, the visible text does not need to remain editable in Figma. Visual fidelity is the priority.
figmaEditability.sourceOfTruthLocation: The exact approved string/number must be recorded in the page manifest, asset metadata or other canonical data. A hidden duplicate native Figma text layer is optional, not mandatory.
figmaEditability.longOrVariableCopy: Long body copy, personal answers, captions, guest data, TBD copy and frequently changing text remain native/editable and must not be baked into fixed display art.

bundledFixedDisplayModulePolicy.bundlingDecisionRule: Bundle only elements that visually behave as one module and are expected to move/scale together. Separate real-photo content, long/variable copy, and independently movable decorations when the Visual Master shows them as distinct objects.
hardRejects: rebuilding an authored fixed badge as generic ellipse + Inter text solely for editability
splitting a fixed feature badge into many Figma primitives when the result becomes UI-like
forcing every fixed word to remain editable at the cost of the Visual Master
baking long/TBD/personal copy into generated art
bundling a replaceable real photo into the decorative module
bundling unrelated decorations only to reduce layer count

fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.rule: Short fixed display text may be image-generated or prepared display art when its visual treatment is part of page identity. This permission is not limited to personal names and may be applied through the bundled display-module policy above.
fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.sourceOfTruthRule: The approved exact string must exist in canonical/page manifest or asset metadata and visible generated spelling must be QA-checked against it. A duplicate native Figma text layer is not required for fixed approved display art.
preferNativeWhen: precision metadata where styling is not identity-critical
hardRejects: choosing generic native type solely because it is easier to edit
baking long or frequently changing copy into raster art
accepting misspelled generated display text
treating generated visible text as the authoritative factual source without canonical metadata

photoProxyContaminationPolicy.principle: A photo proxy must look like photo content only. It must not contain page-layout background, titles, badges, flowers, frames, doodles or other editorial decoration copied from the Visual Master.
why: Visual Master crops can carry baked-in decoration/background into the photo slot
the same decoration may then appear both inside the proxy photo and as a real page layer
it becomes difficult to distinguish photo content from editorial assets
Reference Delta can falsely pass because part of the target layout is already baked into the proxy
allowedProxySources: user-provided real photo suitable for the slot
clean semantically representative standalone photo with no page-layout decoration
clean generated standalone photo used only as a temporary visual proxy, with no attempt to reproduce the Visual Master page composition
photoProxyContaminationPolicy.structuralProxy: May be any clean standalone photo that clearly differs from page decoration; it is for clipping/swap only and cannot pass visual hierarchy QA.
photoProxyContaminationPolicy.visualProxy: Must match subject class/count/orientation/focal mass but remain a clean standalone photograph without page decorations.
hardRejects: cropping P01.png/P02.png/etc and placing that crop inside a photo slot
photo proxies containing the page border, title, badge, route line, flower sticker, ticket, frame or story vessel
using a screenshot of the page as a photo fill
using a proxy whose baked decoration duplicates a separate Figma/generated page asset
claiming Reference Delta pass when proxy contamination exists
qa: confirm it reads as standalone photo content
confirm no page-layout typography or decoration is baked inside
confirm replacement with another clean photo does not remove any intended page decoration
confirm Visual Master comparison is based on page layers, not decoration hidden inside the proxy

editorialIrregularityPolicy.principle: Preserve authored local irregularity from the Visual Master; do not manufacture random messiness and do not normalize the page into UI components.
rules: Do not force equal heights, equal photo sizes, equal padding or equal icon alignment merely for component reuse.
When the Visual Master contains measured differences, preserve them or tune toward them during Reference Delta.
Do not assign arbitrary rotation formulas or random offsets. Any tilt/offset must serve the Visual Master or improve direct visual comparison.
Related modules may share publication DNA without sharing identical geometry.
hardRejects: equal-card normalization
mechanical mirroring
randomized scrapbook rotation with no reference basis
component convenience overriding page silhouette

tactilePrintFinishPolicy.principle: Use restrained tactile/print character to avoid flat digital/AI-sticker appearance, but never apply indiscriminate global grain.
allowedCharacteristics: subtle paper fiber or matte print feel
small local imperfections that support the visual master
avoidOn: real photographs unless part of an approved photo treatment
the entire page as a uniform noise overlay unless the Visual Master explicitly requires it
hardRejects: heavy fake vintage grain
global dirty-paper overlay
texture that reduces A5 readability
texture added merely to make output look less digital
visible compression/noise mistaken for tactile print quality
tactilePrintFinishPolicy.qa: Texture/material treatment must survive A5 readability and Reference Delta; if it becomes the first thing noticed, it is too strong.

visualCarryOverPolicy.principle: A clean Figma layer tree can still contain visually stale production assets. Existing assets receive no grandfathered visual approval merely because they were previously ADOPTED, technically valid, or unchanged in a newer build.

coreDistinctions.layerCleanliness: No hidden/rejected/stale nodes remain in LIVE Figma.
coreDistinctions.assetFreshness: Every visible inherited asset still matches the current Visual Master and current page quality bar.
coreDistinctions.pageCoherence: New and inherited assets read as one authored design language rather than different production eras mixed together.

triggers: a REWORK/CURRENT promotion reuses any production asset from an earlier build
a high-saliency identity anchor or Hero is regenerated/replaced
the page quality bar materially increases after owner feedback
a previously weak area is fixed while neighboring assets are left unchanged
the user reports that old parts still look visible even when stale-layer scan passes
visualCarryOverPolicy.mandatoryAuditScope: Audit every visible inherited production asset, not only files whose node names contain OLD/FIRST/V20. Provenance and appearance both matter.
auditViews: A5-size thumbnail when the asset affects readability or rhythm

statuses.UNREVIEWED_CARRYOVER: Inherited visible asset has not yet been requalified against the current Visual Master/current quality bar.
statuses.KEEP_REQUALIFIED: Inherited asset was explicitly rechecked in the current composition and still fits both Visual Master and current design language.
statuses.REWORK_REQUIRED: Asset job remains valid but its current visual execution is weaker/staler than the current page.
statuses.REPLACE_REQUIRED: Asset's visual concept/job no longer fits and should be rebuilt/replaced rather than patched.
statuses.SUPERSEDED: Asset has been removed from CURRENT and retained only as history/QA evidence.

requiredAuditFieldsPerInheritedAsset: coherence with newly improved neighboring assets
visualCarryOverPolicy.adjacencyRequalificationRule: When a high-saliency anchor/Hero is materially improved, automatically reopen nearby supporting assets for requalification. Improving a title can make an old ribbon, ticket, feature vessel or badge visibly obsolete even if that asset did not itself regress.
visualCarryOverPolicy.maintainedDefinition: MAINTAINED is allowed only after explicit current-build requalification. 'Unchanged since first build' is not evidence. 'No regression' is insufficient if the asset remains materially behind the Visual Master or newly raised surrounding quality bar.

coherenceGate.question: Does the page look like one authored magazine cover/page, or like new identity anchors placed on top of older UI-like production parts?
failExamples: new expressive masthead + old generic feature-card vessels
new premium display lettering + old flat/cheap ticket or badge
new people-led Hero + support modules whose scale/material/rhythm still belong to the previous draft
mixed outline/shadow/material systems that reveal different production eras

visualCarryOverPolicy.promotionRule: A candidate may become the best CURRENT working version while carry-over debt remains, but it must be labeled PROMOTED_CURRENT_WITH_CARRYOVER_DEBT and cannot claim final REFERENCE_DELTA_PASS / FIGMA_DESIGN_COMPLETE until all material inherited assets are KEEP_REQUALIFIED, REWORKED, REPLACED or explicitly user-deferred.
hardRejects: treating ADOPTED as permanent visual approval
passing carry-over because node names are clean
keeping an old asset only because generation effort was already spent
marking an inherited asset PASS/MAINTAINED without explicit current-build comparison
allowing new and old design languages to coexist because the page is technically layered/editable

pageApplicationRequirement.rule: Before any P01-P08 part generation, each page must classify its fixed display modules and photo slots. A page-specific manifest/polish manifest must state which visible short modules may be bundled into one generated asset and which copy must remain native/TBD.
pageApplicationRequirement.pendingPages: For pages still awaiting visual review, do not invent the module list from prose. Add the classification during the actual Visual Master PASS A/PASS B review.

feedbackDebtPolicy.rule: A newly discovered systemic failure pattern reopens FEEDBACK_DEBT even if the previous feedback cycle was closed. Closing one debt does not freeze future acceptance rules.
feedbackDebtPolicy.currentP01Lesson: P01 proved that page promotion and page completion are separate decisions; it also proved that Visual Master crops are unsuitable photo proxies when they include page decoration, that fixed display modules can be better generated as complete visible objects rather than editable Figma subparts, and that manifest feedback should be completed before another Figma cycle begins.
feedbackDebtPolicy.blockScalingRule: Do not scale a production method to later pages while a newly discovered systemic carry-over/display-module/proxy failure remains unmodeled or unaudited.

acceptanceRule: These policies are mandatory execution overrides for P01-P08. Structural QA, stale-layer scans, prior ADOPTED status, editable-text preference, older proxy-source rules, or implementation momentum cannot waive manifest-first feedback closure, bundled-module fidelity, clean-photo-proxy, carry-over or coherence review.
